question.text: A Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) is sent to mutual fund investors on a monthly basis for months with transactions. For folios with no transactions during a half-year period, the CAS is sent ________.

answer.text: Only on specific request by the investor

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook rule is straightforward: investors who have transactions during a month receive a monthly CAS for that month, and folios with no transactions during a half-year period receive a half-yearly CAS for that period. The half-yearly statement therefore covers folios that were dormant over the six-month window. The Trap: "Quarterly" (Option B) overstates the frequency for non-transaction folios. "Annually" (Option C) understates it — investors with no transactions still receive CAS twice a year. "Only on request" (Option D) is wrong; the half-yearly CAS is issued without a request. Note: A transaction here refers to a purchase, redemption, switch, dividend, SIP/SWP/STP instalment, or other folio-level financial movement.
